items.title: Sidney "Jim Little" Brown Interview, 1960-05-27
items.q: But Sam Morgan had he had Alfred playing drums.

ctx.x: And Joe Watson playing clarinet. You heard about Joe Watson playing clarinet. Did they have a bass player then?
Before you? Yes, they had a bass player before me at that time. And I'll finish telling you about the other man or two, what Sam Morgan had. But Sam Morgan had he had Alfred playing drums.
